claims.scope: Sources that are unions of at most r pairwise disjoint affine cosets, r fixed, under the specified genuine Boolean selector splice and adaptive nonreusing restrictions
claims.statement: For r>=3, Omega <= (8 r ln r + 4/e) I(d), and weighted adaptive occurrences are paid once from root source influence.
For r physically disjoint pieces, E_raw(sum_j s_j) <= r sum_j E_raw(s_j)+p/e.
For disjoint affine cosets of densities p_j=2^-k_j, sum_j p_j k_j <= 2I(sum_j 1_Ej)+p log_2 r.
